newsitem.title: USA: Omaha Public nuke at 45 pct ahead of Oct 5 refuel.
newsitem.headline: Omaha Public nuke at 45 pct ahead of Oct 5 refuel.

text.p: Omaha Public Power District said its 478 megawatt Fort Calhoun nuclear power plant in Fort Calhoun, Neb. was expected to operate at just under half of its capacity through this week ahead of a scheduled outage.

"The unit is coming down in two stages," company spokesman Gary Williams said Monday, adding that the second stage of the reduction took the plant down to the 45 percent level, where it will stay until full shutdown beginning Oct 5.
The maintenance and refueling outage will last about 44 days until mid-November.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
